subject: Negotiating PO format, invoice cadence, and discount banding for ProspectCo
messages:
From: Lauren Pierce <lpierce@prospectco.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@prospectco.com
Date: 2026-08-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO requirements and payment terms (ProspectCo)

Hi Rishi / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to start the paperwork. A few asks from our side so we can feed this into our ERP: 

- They require a purchase order that includes: Redwood legal entity, Redwood tax ID, PO number (we generate), and the contract effective dates.
- Invoice cadence: ProspectCo prefers consolidated monthly invoices (one invoice per month across all accounts). Is that supported?
- Net terms: our standard is Net60. Would Redwood accept Net60 for a first-year commitment?
- Discounting: our sourcing team prefers pricing bucketed by committed usage tiers. Can you confirm whether you can add a 10% band at $250k ARR and 15% at $500k?

I attached our PO template for your ops team. Also can you send Redwood's W-9 and any standard SOW template you'd like signed?

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Pierce
Head of Strategic Sourcing, ProspectCo
[Attachment: ProspectCo_PO_template.pdf (PDF)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Lauren Pierce <lpierce@prospectco.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and payment terms (ProspectCo)

Hi Lauren — great to kick this off. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

- Consolidated monthly invoice: yes, we support a single monthly invoice across a customer entity. For multi-entity customers we can consolidate if we have the correct BU mapping.
- Net terms: Finance is typically Net45 for new enterprise customers; Net60 is possible but we need a brief credit check and an approval from Finance (standard for Net60).
- Discount bands: we can provide tiered discounts. The 10% at $250k / 15% at $500k are plausible as list-level discounts but final approval depends on contract length and commit cadence (annual vs. multi-year).

Actions: Vanessa, can you scope the proposed committed volumes and confirm whether ProspectCo expects a 12- or 24-month commit? Priyom, please review the PO template and flag any fields we need to push back on. Finance (cc'ing Neha) — please note the Net60 ask and advise on approval path.

Lauren — attaching our standard SOW and Redwood W-9 for your records. If you can sign the SOW and upload a filled PO that includes our tax ID, we can route to legal for a quick stamp.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v2.docx]
[Attachment: Redwood_W9_and_tax.pdf]

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: PO requirements and payment terms (ProspectCo)

Folks — reviewed ProspectCo_PO_template.pdf. A few fields to note that tend to block PO acceptance on our side: 

1) "Ship To / Bill To" — we need the bill-to legal name to match the Redwood legal entity exactly (note: our legal entity is Redwood Inference, Inc.).
2) "Invoice Remittance Address" — they have a lockbox field; finance will accept lockbox but needs the ACH wiring instructions included as a separate line or on the invoice.
3) "Service Description" — their template groups charges as a single line item. We prefer line-level skus (model serving, dedicated hours, storage) to reconcile against usage. If ProspectCo needs a single line item for procurement, we can provide an internal breakdown PDF attached to the invoice.
4) "PO Effective / End Date" — they left it blank. We need explicit effective and expiration dates to line up with the SOW.

Recommendation: ask them to populate the PO exactly (bill-to = Redwood Inference, Inc.; include PO number), accept consolidated monthly invoice, and we agree to Net60 conditionally for 90 days pending credit check. For the 10%/15% discount bands — propose to make them volume-based annualized commitments (i.e., $250k ARR over 12 months).

Marissa, want me to draft the discount phrasing for the SOW? I can add the clause: "Tiered discount applies on annualized spend and is effective upon execution of the SOW and receipt of a valid PO."

-Priyom
Sales Operations

[Quoted message below]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-28T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: RE: PO requirements and payment terms (ProspectCo)

Thanks for the heads up — Finance here. A few points on Net60: 

- Net60 is an acceptable term for strategic customers but requires a light credit review and an approved exception ticket. For new customers we typically require Net45 until credit completes. If the customer provides corporate guarantor or prepayment tranche we can move to Net60 immediately.
- For the consolidated monthly invoice: please ensure when the invoice is submitted it includes a line item mapping (internal) so our AR team can apply payments properly.
- Lockbox/ACH: we will accept lockbox but require the remittance instructions to be present on each invoice.

If you want to offer Net60 as a sales concession, I recommend: (a) a 90-day pilot under Net45, and (b) contingent Net60 approval if the credit review is clean. That protects Redwood while keeping the deal moving.

I'll open the internal exception request if you confirm you want to pursue Net60 now.

-Neha
Director, Finance Ops

[In-thread: ProspectCo asked about 10%/15% bands — those need to be defined as annualized spend thresholds for Finance to model margins.]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Lauren Pierce <lpierce@prospectco.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Agreed PO fields, discount buckets, and next steps

Lauren — thanks for the patience and for sending the PO template. Summarizing the agreed points so we can proceed to signature: 

1) PO fields: ProspectCo will return a completed PO that lists bill-to as "Redwood Inference, Inc." and includes the PO number, effective date (start) and end date to match the SOW. ProspectCo agreed to include the lockbox remittance address and will add ACH wiring instructions on the invoice copy.
2) Invoice cadence: Redwood will issue one consolidated invoice per month for all charges tied to this account. The invoice will include an internal breakdown PDF with line-level SKUs for reconciliation.
3) Net terms: ProspectCo requested Net60. Redwood agrees to Net60 subject to a credit review. Per Neha's note, we will accept Net45 for the first 90 days and escalate to Net60 upon clean credit approval.
4) Discount bands: ProspectCo's requested bands (10% @ $250k ARR, 15% @ $500k ARR) will be formalized as annualized committed spend tiers in the SOW. The discount applies to billable usage once the annualized threshold is reached; first-year proration rules will be included.

Next steps: 
- Lauren: please return the filled PO and indicate whether ProspectCo is committing to a 12- or 24-month term for the tiers above.
- Rishi / Vanessa: once we have the PO, Legal will run the SOW + PO together and route for signatures.
- Neha: please open the Net60 exception request ticket pending receipt of PO and completed credit packet.

If that matches your view, Lauren, we'll prepare a redline SOW that captures the discount language and the invoicing mechanics and share a DocuSign link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
